sources.snippet: Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models in Qwen series, offering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. Built upon extensive training, Qwen3 delivers groundbreaking advancements in reasoning, instruction-following, agent capabilities, and multilingual support.

sources.title: Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8 is a 30.5 billion parameter mixture-of-experts language model from Qwen that activates only 3.3 billion parameters per token, built with 48 layers, 32 query attention heads, 4 key-value attention heads, 128 total experts with 8 activated, and a native context window of 32,768 tokens (extending to 131,072 with YaRN).
